fieldValues.title: Validation relaxations
fieldValues.content: An RFC-026-aware validator MUST NOT treat the following as errors when a `slice` block is present: `externalRelationRefs` UUIDs absent from `instanceIndex`; absence of unreferenced type/field definitions; an incomplete `containerIndex`; tombstoned source document entries with absent content files. Dangling edges in the relations collection, unresolvable `typeId`/`fieldId` references, and instance schema validation errors remain errors regardless of slice status.
